items.lede: At the OCP Global Summit, AMD revealed Helion, a rack-scale reference design for agentic AI that can house up to 32,768 Zen 6 CPU cores.
items.title: AMD debuts Helion reference design for agentic AI servers with up to 32,768 Zen 6 ‘Venice’ cores

items.lede: CPU-only and mixed CPU/GPU configurations due from partners in November
items.title: AMD unveils Helion racks for AI agents at OCP summit
